hub.title: Red Rocks Transportation
hub.description: How to get to Red Rocks: shuttle vs rideshare, parking reality, and post-show pickup strategy.

leaves.title: Shuttle vs Uber at Red Rocks
leaves.description: Cost, reliability, surge pricing, and the best return strategy after the encore.

cards.p: Shuttles are fixed. Rideshares spike post-show and can exceed expectations, especially after sellouts.
Pickup depends on lot control, queue length, and driver availability. Shuttles run on schedule.
If you rideshare, leave slightly before the final rush or wait it out. If you shuttle, treat it like a reservation.

leaves.title: Red Rocks Parking Reality
leaves.description: Arrival timing, overflow lots, and what actually happens on busy nights.

cards.p: The earlier you arrive, the better your lot and exit. Late arrivals risk overflow and long hikes.
When primary lots fill, you’re walking. Budget time and bring layers for post-show temps.
The show ends and everyone moves at once. Your lot placement and patience matter.

leaves.title: Post-Show Pickup Strategy (Red Rocks)
leaves.description: Where to meet, best pickup windows, and how to avoid the chaos after the encore.

cards.p: Leaving immediately can mean gridlock. Waiting 15–25 minutes can make pickup faster and cheaper.
Pick a specific landmark and communicate it. “I’m by the stairs” is not a plan.
Crowds strain networks. Agree on a fallback plan before the encore ends.
